g.text: Endpoint labels show 2022–2025 employment growth. The dashed line marks 2023; shading identifies 2023–2025.
Fixed 2025 AI exposure groups throughout. Annual survey-weighted mean of April and October employment.
The calendar boundary follows the emergence of widely available generative AI. It does not measure workplace adoption.
Indices describe employment stocks; age-specific vertical ranges preserve detail and do not represent employment rates.
